continuity_conflict.details: Major conflict with Series Bible: Male lead is named 'Asher' instead of 'Elias Crane'. The backstory involves a brother 'Julian' being pushed by 'Lydia', contradicting the Bible's established mystery (Ilse's fire/suicide) and Elias's backstory (sister's death). Additionally, finding the bear 'Wick' in Chapter 10 contradicts the Bible which states the bear is found in Book 1.

fail_reasons: Male lead name is Asher (Bible: Elias Crane)
Backstory contradicts Bible (Julian/Lydia murder vs Ilse fire/sister death)
Bear found in Ch 10 instead of Book 1 per Bible arc
